prompt: Create an original 150 second lo-fi instrumental hip hop instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: Rhodes piano, muted drums, warm bass. Style: laid-back swung beat and hazy jazz harmony. Tempo approximately 74 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A chill, atmospheric electronic track featuring synth pads, arpeggios, and a steady electronic beat. It evokes a dreamy and relaxed mood.
description.zh: 一首轻松、大气的电子音乐，以合成器铺垫、琶音和稳定的电子节拍为特色。营造出梦幻而放松的氛围。
